target_questions.question: How do bow-shock pressure rise and liquid volatility bound vaporization under locally supersonic droplet-relative flow?
target_questions.target_basis: Tier 1 C024/C031 couple breakup and phase change; this experiment adds a locally supersonic superheating boundary.

evidence_candidates.claim_text: The observed locally supersonic droplet vaporization is bounded by relative Mach number, bow-shock static-pressure rise, and test-liquid vapor pressure; lower shock pressure rise and higher volatility favor superheating effects.
evidence_candidates.evidence_summary: The experiment compares its relative-Mach/pressure environment with earlier higher-pressure-rise studies to explain differing vaporization behavior.

core_links.shared_parameter_or_mechanism: breakup and vaporization under high-speed compressible loading

limitations: Interpretation combines direct observations with bow-shock estimates and cross-study comparison; definitions and liquids differ.
visual_verification: Targeted visual verification performed where numeric/glyph-dependent abstract claims required it; no figure digitization.
